name: How can I make my kitchen more functional during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my kitchen more functional during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To enhance kitchen functionality, consider the 'work triangle' (sink, refrigerator, stove) to ensure efficient movement. Incorporate smart storage solutions like pull-out pantry shelves, drawer organizers, and corner cabinet solutions to maximize space. Think about appliance placement for ease of use and traffic flow. Adding an island can provide extra prep space and seating. Good lighting, including task and ambient options, also significantly improves usability. We focus on optimizing your kitchen's layout for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve functionality by optimizing the work triangle, adding smart storage solutions, considering appliance placement, and ensuring adequate lighting and prep space.
